effects.label: Shield
effects.description: Gives the recipient a HP Shield. All damage the recipient takes will be subtracted from the Shield first, before their HP.Each Skill can only cast one Shield at a time on each recipient.

effects.label: Skill Recovery Up
effects.description: Increases the recipient's Skill Recovery stat by the indicated percentage.

levels.text:
Attacks 10 random enemies in a 15m radius, from a distance of 9m, dealing 124 damage. 
Then, casts one of the following buff pairs:
- Pair A: If Charvaine's DEF is higher than her ATK. 
Casts a [40% DEF Up] buff on 10 random allies in a 15m radius, lasting 12s. Then, casts a [153 HP Shield] buff on the targets, lasting 12s. 
- Pair B: If Charvaine's ATK is higher than her DEF. 
Casts a [40% ATK Up] buff on 10 random allies in a 15m radius, lasting 12s. Then, casts a [30% Crit Rate Up] buff on the targets, lasting 12s. 
Also casts the following buff pair if Charvaine has 75% MAX HP or higher:
- Pair C: Casts a [20% Skill Recovery Up] buff on 10 random allies in a 15m radius, lasting 12s. Then, the targets gain 75 Ultimate Mana.
#1 Damage: 157.5% ATK
#2 Shield: MAX HP * 15%

bio: When people speak of the grandest Magi in history, Charvaine's name is never far from the conversation. With her dazzling hat Arcana focusing her thoughts, she unlocked the secrets of hypnomancy - a bizarre form of magic that taps into Amara's collective unconscious. A dream for her. A nightmare for others.
